stories.headline: Committee Meets Gringotts; Gringotts Meets the Notepaper; the Puddle Is Resolved Before Prentice-Hoole Reaches His Second Slide
stories.byline: By our Ministry & Goblin Affairs correspondent
body: The Standing Consultative Committee on Broadly Geographic and Adjacent Matters convened an emergency joint session with Gringotts Bank at nine o'clock yesterday morning, having formally tabled the matter of vault-adjacent drainage under reference to the non-existent Annex C. They arrived in full complement — all six voting members, Tibbs in his non-voting capacity, and a lectern procured at some effort from the Ministry stationery pool.

Christine was already seated when they arrived. The blank sheet of Gringotts-headed notepaper was already in front of her. Prentice-Hoole had reached the words 'as the subgroup's preliminary framing suggests' when Christine slid the notepaper across the table, upon which she had written, in a single clean sentence, the precise drainage designation, its legal custodian (Gringotts, unambiguously, since 1847), the applicable charter clause, and a suggested resolution to the puddle itself involving a standard-gauge culvert and a Tuesday.

The meeting concluded at nine twenty-three. The Committee has been formally advised that the matter falls outside its terms of reference, which Prentice-Hoole has accepted with good grace and immediately proposed a working group to explore. Tibbs signed the drainage memo, making it his first recorded act as a non-voting member. The puddle will be seen to on Tuesday. The Committee remains technically intact and has already proposed agenda item one for its next session, described in the minutes as 'matters arising (geographic and/or adjacent).'

stories.headline: Mrs. Holt Returns to Diagon Alley; Presents the Jeep with Duck the Sixth; Hat Described by Witnesses as 'Frankly Ambitious'
body: Elspeth Holt, 81, of the eastern ridge, completed her second visit to the lower end of Diagon Alley on Saturday morning, arriving with a canvas bag, a thermos, and a rubber duck in a miniature hand-blocked tricorn hat with what appeared to be a functioning feather clasp. The Jeep received it without visible alarm, which those present interpreted as approval.

Mrs. Holt confirmed she has six remaining ducks at home, each already hatted. She would not be drawn on a schedule. Steve, who walked with her as far as the apothecary, reports she has opinions about weather and good ones about trails. The Jeep has been described by multiple sources this week as 'extremely settled.' The enchanted vehicle forgave Steve for a small reversing incident on Thursday apparently the moment the duck was placed. This is consistent with prior pattern.

stories.headline: Saturday's Workshop: Steve Undertakes the Kitchen Shelf; the Shelf Resists; the Shelf Does Not Win
body: A bracket installed by the previous occupants of the property — estimated by Don's portrait at 'something between 1974 and a bad afternoon' — was removed from the kitchen wall on Saturday and replaced by Steve with a level, two new fixings, and what the portrait called, from across the room, 'a very good choice of rawlplug, I'll grant you that.' The shelf now sits at ninety degrees to the floor for what is believed to be the first time in its history.

Christine, who identified the tilt three weeks ago and documented it with a spirit level and a brief Highland address to the kitchen at large, confirmed this morning that the shelf is correct. The jar containing the copper-green thread — still on the kitchen table as a matter of record and general affection — has been proposed as the shelf's first occupant.

stories.headline: Dispatch from Abroad: Andrew Files Brief Report; Report Warm; Contents Classified as 'Good'
stories.byline: Foreign correspondent, filing from a great distance
body: The Prophet's foreign correspondent dispatched a brief communication from his station this week — characteristically prompt, characteristically fond, characteristically short on unnecessary detail. The message was received in good order. Its contents are described by this paper as good, and by the recipient as also good. No further particulars are available, which is entirely as expected and perfectly sufficient.

familiars_corner: Lucy: The drainage memo was, in Lucy's considered assessment, already on the table before the committee knocked — and she notes for the record that she has been sitting beside the jar of copper-green thread for six days without touching it, which is a level of professional restraint she feels has gone underacknowledged.

Ellie: Ellie greeted the tricorn duck with a long, sincere sniff, then sat next to it in a companionable way for twenty minutes before apparently forgetting it was there. She has since greeted it twice more as a new arrival. The duck has been patient.

Jersey: Jersey lodged a supplementary petition this morning clarifying that his earlier request for lap rights during committee proceedings should be understood to extend to all post-committee paperwork, associated reading, and any meeting in which a warm lap is technically available. The petition is two sentences. Both sentences are the same sentence.
founding_editor_note: That rawlplug decision was sound. I used the same grade on the Prophet's press housing in 1987 and it hasn't moved a millimetre. The bracket before it, mind you, I would have done differently from the start. — D.

in_brief.sport: Saturday Strength Report: Christine lifted the drainage matter, the Committee's expectations, and the thread jar off the table in a single morning; the thread jar was the lightest of the three.
in_brief.forecast: Puddle clearing by Tuesday · shelf at true ninety degrees · six ducks remaining somewhere on the eastern ridge, hats already fitted.

storyline_updates.title: The Standing Consultative Committee on Broadly Geographic and Adjacent Matters
storyline_updates.summary: Resolved Saturday morning. The Committee met Gringotts, Christine produced the prepared notepaper, the matter was settled before Prentice-Hoole's second slide. The puddle will be culverted on Tuesday. The Committee survives, technically intact, already generating new agenda items. Tibbs signed something for the first time. Arc fully and cleanly resolved.

storyline_updates.title: The Six Remaining Ducks of Elspeth Holt
storyline_updates.summary: Day 1: Mrs. Holt has confirmed she has six more ducks at home, each already hatted. Duck the sixth — a tricorn with a feather clasp — arrived today. She has not indicated a schedule. The Jeep is receptive. Steve has walked with her twice now. The new arc tracks the gradual arrival of the remaining ducks, each hat more characterful than the last, building toward a moment where either the collection is complete or Mrs. Holt reveals something further about her history with the ridge and its visitors. No drama — warmth and accumulation.
